scope: Wing-only feather material correction for Astronaut, Alien and Dark Matter.
geometry: All vertices, topology, object transforms and skin weights of every approved base and accessory mesh are identical. Wings unchanged. UV coordinates and materials repainted.
textures: 2048-square body maps with feather color, shallow tangent normal relief, lower metalness and soft roughness on both wings. All non-wing pixels unchanged. Visor maps remain 1024 square.
runtime: Rendered in Blender; GLB and FBX files regenerated. Not imported, uploaded, or tested in Roblox.
icons: Transparent PNGs with an external black silhouette stroke and unclipped margins.
